id: De Best Verzorgde Boeken (The Best Dutch Book Designs)
title: De Best Verzorgde Boeken (The Best Dutch Book Designs)
info: The Best Dutch Book Designs는 매년 네덜란드 그래픽 산업의 최고 결과물, 곧 정성을 다해 만든 33권의 책을 선정합니다. 뛰어난 디자인과 의뢰, 고품질 인쇄·제본이 결합된 책들입니다. 심사는 1월 말에 이루어지고 3월에 발표되며, 2016년부터는 전문 심사위원단과 함께 학생 심사위원단도 운영합니다. Every year, The Best Dutch Book Designs celebrates the best products of the graphic industry in the Netherlands: 33 books made with heart and soul. Books set apart by the combination of great design and commissioning with high-quality lithography, printing and bindings. The jury assessment takes place at the end of January, with the announcement in March. Since 2016, in addition to the professional jury, a student jury has been established.

>
> Every year, The Best Dutch Book Designs celebrates the best products of the graphic industry in the Netherlands: 33 books made with heart and soul. Books set apart by the combination of great design and commissioning with high-quality lithography, printing and bindings. The jury assessment takes place at the end of January, with the announcement in March. Since 2016, in addition to the professional jury, a student jury has been established.
